title: COLD STORAGE IS LIT FOR WORK
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, gritty and grounded like ARC Raiders. Every district on COLD STORAGE was lit the same way: a lamp or two per building and the odd post. Now each part of the map is lit like what it is: rows of cold white strip lights hang over the PACKING FLOOR aisles, sickly green lamps flicker down in THE SUMP, and big sodium floods on posts light the walls of the SCRAP LINE. The lamps are placed by hand on a fixed grid, so the map, the loot and the machines are exactly where they were, and light is only drawn: it does not change who sees you.
now: COLD STORAGE now has strip lights over the PACKING FLOOR aisles, flickering lamps in THE SUMP and floodlights on the SCRAP LINE.
